listing.name: Ship&Weapon Editor 3.7.5
listing.summary: Provides a tool for editing ship hulls, variants, skins, stations, and weapons with support for Windows, Wine/Linux, and native Linux.
listing.aiSummary: Provides a tool for editing ship hulls, variants, skins, stations, and weapons with support for Windows, Wine/Linux, and native Linux.

description:
A familiar editor with a few new tricks.

The source has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers.

Runs under Windows, Wine/Linux and the native Linux version.

A selection of added functionsSkin Ship and Variant editor

Combined, Module Center and Station Module on Parent position adjuster

Raw File editor

Additional added functions:

-Multi mod de/activator

-Linux installation Path support

[close]

Noteable bugfixesFixed Station Module mount function. Does not crash and works instead.

Fixed a t behing added to the first line after opening any csv editor.

[close]

ReadmeThe buttonmapping (not changeable yet) and general functions of Sf Edit Ed

Start the program (sf-ship-ed.exe)

The in-editor Help menu shows the controls available in the current mode.

The editor opens in Hull Mode.

1 = Hull Mode

2 = Variant Mode

3 = Station Mode

4 = Skin Mode

5 = Skin Variant Mode

6 = Ship Stats

7 = Fighter Wing Stats

8 = Weapon Mode

9 = Weapon Stats

0 = Projectile Mode placeholder

I = Load an image or sprite

D = Load data for the current mode

V = Save data for the current mode

T = Edit details

Ctrl + T = Edit the active raw JSON file

Ctrl + Z = Undo

Ctrl + Y = Redo

Press 1 to enter Hull Mode.

Press M to open the loaded mod window (works almost everywhere).

Press I to load the ship sprite.

Press D to load an existing .ship file.

Press V to save the current .ship file.

CENTER AND COLLISION RADIUS

Press C to enter center editing.

Click to set the ship center.

Ctrl + Click to set the collision radius.

COLLISION BOUNDS

Press B to enter Bounds Mode.

Shift + Click adds a bounds point.

Ctrl + Click inserts a bounds point.

Click and drag moves an existing point.

Backspace removes the selected point.

Space toggles mirrored editing where supported.

WEAPON SLOTS

Press W to enter Weapon Slot Mode.

Shift + Click adds a weapon slot.

Click and drag sets its direction.

Ctrl + Click and drag moves an existing slot.

Alt + Click and drag changes the weapon arc.

Press T to edit the selected slot details.

Press Backspace to remove the selected slot.

BUILT-IN WEAPONS

Press U to enter Built-In Weapons Mode.

ENGINE SLOTS

Press E to enter Engine Slot Mode.

Shift + Click adds an engine slot.

Click and drag sets its direction.

Ctrl + Click and drag moves the engine.

Alt + Click and drag changes its length and width.

Press T to edit the selected engine details.

Press Backspace to remove the selected engine.

STATION MODE

Press M = Opens move station mount on parent mode

Press C = Opens move module center under module mode

Press K = Opens move station mount + module center

LAUNCH BAYS

Press L to enter Launch Bay Mode.

Shift + Click adds a launch port to the current bay.

Ctrl + Click creates a new launch bay.

Click and drag moves a launch port.

Backspace removes the selected launch port.

Press 2 to enter Variant Mode.

Press D to load an existing .variant file.

Press T to edit general variant data.

Press G to edit weapon groups.

Press A while editing weapon groups to toggle autofire.

Press F to add a flux vent.

Press Ctrl + F to remove a flux vent.

Press C to add a flux capacitor.

Press Ctrl + C to remove a flux capacitor.

Press H to select hullmods.

Press V to save the current .variant file.

Press 4 to enter Skin Mode.

Skin Mode edits a .skin file on top of an existing base hull.

It can edit supported skin changes including:

LOCAL RAW TEXT CONTROLS

Press Ctrl + T in:

Hull Mode

Skin Mode

Variant Mode

Skin Variant Mode

>

Apply = Validates the JSON and applies it to the active editor data.

Direct Save = It then opens a Save As dialog and writes the exact raw text.

Cancel = Closes the raw editor without applying unapplied changes.

Ctrl + Z = Undo text change

Ctrl + Y = Redo text change

Crtl + C = Copy

Crtl + X = Cut

Crtl + A = Mark All

Crtl + V = Paste

-The raw editor opens the active .ship, .skin or .variant file.

-Keep backups of files before editing them.

-Check saved files before releasing a mod.

-In station mode it is possible that multiple save actions happen one after the other.[close]

LocalisationIs not ready yet but its not far off.[close]

Download Button:

Changelog is deployed in program folder at first launch.

To make sure all files get deployed correctly purge the old program files the exe deployed in the installation folder.

This is a fork of Deathflys Ship and weapon editor version Alpha 11.

Deathfly's ship editor

Dazs

aiDescription: Offers a comprehensive editor for modifying game assets including hulls, variants, station modules, and weapon slots. Includes features like raw file editing, multi-mod activation, and collision bound adjustments. The source code has been updated to work with the newest BlitzMax Compilers.
